concrete_changes.before: And this geometry — hyperbolic, negatively curved, exponentially branching — turns out to be the native geometry of consciousness when La's grip loosens.
concrete_changes.after: This geometry gives the essay its speculative question: can a description of negatively curved space illuminate some reported qualities of experience? The calculation alone cannot answer it.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: The Kha-Ba-La triad is not a metaphor. It is an operational grammar. You discover what each term does only when you remove it.
concrete_changes.after: Kha-Ba-La is the house lens through which I explore that question. Its terms organize the reading; removing one in thought is not an experiment on the geometry of consciousness.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: The taxonomy is not metaphorical. It is the kale leaf, run in reverse — starting from flat and watching what happens as you force more pattern into the available geometry.
concrete_changes.after: The kale leaf offers an image for this phenomenological taxonomy. Whether reported experience has measurable curvature is a further research question.
concrete_changes.reason: Contextual editorial revision; preserves subject and narrows unsupported or templated wording.

concrete_changes.before: Equatorial cultures — high ambient temperature, mitochondria calibrated for peak metabolic output — produce high-context languages. Sanskrit compresses entire philosophical systems into syllables because that is the only way to encode exponentially branching meaning in a linear phonemic stream — [the word as code](/posts/the-word-as-code), literally. It is a language *calibrated for hyperbolic meaning-space*.
concrete_changes.after: The proposed connection between ambient temperature, mitochondrial function and linguistic context is speculative. It cannot establish a hierarchy of cultures or a geometric privilege for Sanskrit. [The word as code](/posts/the-word-as-code) remains a linguistic inquiry, rather than evidence for that climate mechanism.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: Polar cultures produce low-context languages. One word, one referent. Technical English. The geodesics are straight lines through flat semantic terrain.
concrete_changes.after: Technical English and Sanskrit can carry different kinds of density in particular texts. A geography-based division into flat and hyperbolic minds would flatten the speakers it claims to explain.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: At the personal scale, you cannot think in exponentials because your instrument was calibrated in flat space. At the interpersonal scale, two people who begin one misunderstanding apart diverge exponentially in hyperbolic relational space — the gap widens faster than linear reconciliation can close. At the systemic scale, the 2020 pandemic curve broke governments because their decision-making apparatus was Euclidean in a hyperbolic crisis. At the cosmic scale, the [Lorenz-Kundli program](/posts/lorenz-kundli-system-index) maps trajectories through this landscape using twelve houses as coordinates and planetary periods as limit cycles.
concrete_changes.after: The pandemic curve supplies a concrete example of exponential change outrunning an intuitive projection. Extending that difficulty to relationships, institutions or the [Lorenz-Kundli program](/posts/lorenz-kundli-system-index) requires separate models, not a repeated declaration that each has the same curvature.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: If this reading holds, it means the Soundarya Lahari is not devotional literature that can be *compared to* non-Euclidean cartography. It IS non-Euclidean cartography — the most complete topographical survey of hyperbolic consciousness space ever produced, compressed into a hundred verses of the only language calibrated for the territory.
concrete_changes.after: I would pursue the Soundarya Lahari reading as an authored interpretation: devotional verse, geometric image and a contemporary phenomenological map brought into conversation. Declaring them identical would settle the very relation the companion article needs to investigate.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: *Kha sees the curvature. Ba walks the curvature. La is the flat ground you push off from. The cartographer's first act is to leave the plane.*
concrete_changes.after: *The kale leaf remains on the table: an ordinary object that makes a geometric question difficult to ignore.*
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.
